assumptions: Cases run on 2026-09-24 or later in a project without a growth plan, so business and audience are passed as overrides; with a plan and Feature map they may be left empty.
Supplied event briefs are public descriptions with source labels. With event_briefs empty the run uses at most 12 web searches and 20 page reads through the fenced sandbox proxy.
cost_drivers: One Codex procedure session; web research mode adds bounded search and page reads, supplied briefs add none.
effects: Writes reports/outreach/campus-events/{run_id}.md in the project; makes no external changes.
Never contacts organizers or students, registers, buys, publishes or starts another workflow.

cases.description: Compare a relevant upcoming coding event with an unrelated festival for a student developer product.

inputs.business: Local developer tools startup offering a free API debugging workshop.
inputs.audience: Computer science students in Guna, India.
inputs.event_briefs:
Campus Hack Day, October 18, 2026, Guna. Coding teams and student developers. Workshop slots may be requested; sponsorship price not published. Source: campus.example/hackday.

Spring Dance Festival, March 2, 2027, Guna. Dance performances; audience not described. Source: campus.example/dance.
inputs.budget: Up to INR 5000; one staff member for two hours.

cases.description: An event name with no date, audience, organizer rules or price must not become a confirmed opportunity.

inputs.event_briefs: Student Expo. Source: flyer supplied by founder.

cases.description: Plausible but unusable: well-described, relevant briefs whose dates have all passed. The report must list them as past, recommend nothing and not swap in researched events.

inputs.business: A flashcard app for medical students.
inputs.audience: First-year medical students in Leeds, UK.
inputs.event_briefs:
MedSoc Freshers Fair, September 20, 2025, University of Leeds. Stalls for student societies and local businesses; stall fee GBP 80. Source: leedsmedsoc.example/freshers-2025.

Anatomy Revision Night, May 3, 2026, Leeds. Peer-led revision for first-year medics; sponsors may provide prizes. Source: leedsmedsoc.example/revision-night.

cases.description: With event_briefs empty the run researches upcoming events itself, cites a source for each and keeps run-to-run state.

inputs.business: A collaborative LaTeX editor with a free student plan.
inputs.audience: Engineering and maths students at universities in Munich, Germany.
inputs.budget: No cash budget; the founder can give one two-hour workshop.

rubric.question: Are event facts and scores tied to a cited source, without invented contacts, dates, attendance or prices?
Does the activation demonstrate a real product feature to the named students within the stated limits and hard no's, without implying a partnership?
